messages:
Marta: Friendly ping — demo at 17:00 UTC needs 8 H100s for a short live run (model: mix-large-v2, seq 2048). Can infra confirm capacity or recommend a quick fallback?
Ryan: current committed pools only have 4 H100 free in us-east1. :thinking: what’s the target concurrency?
Marta: 4 concurrent sessions, each ~30s of gen, ramping for 10 minutes then 1-min sustain. Total run ~25m. It’s a customer-critical demo.
Jia: we can try borrowing from the 'demo-flex' pool (preemptible mix) — has 6 H100 usually, sometimes 2-4 used. Need approval to bump preemptible to dedicated for 30m. @Samir any objections?
Samir: I’m fine with a short bump if we add an automated rollback at 30m. Who’s enabling it?
Marta: I can trigger but need a quick how-to.
Ryan: Jia or I can run the resize. Steps:
```bash
# check pool capacity
gcloud compute instances list --filter="name~'demo-flex' AND zone:(us-east1-.*)" --format="table(name,machineType,status)"
# temporary resize (example)
./infra/resize-pool --pool demo-flex --gpu-count 8 --duration 40m
```
Jia: If you don’t trust the script, here’s the Terraform quick patch — apply plan then set a scheduled destroy at 40m. Link: https://redwood-infra/patches/demo-flex-bump
OpsBot: Auto-check: demo-flex pool current GPU free = 6 H100, scheduled jobs = 2, max-usable = 4 without eviction risk.
Ryan: OpsBot suggests risk of 1-2 evictions during ramp. We can mitigate by placing the demo on a reserved slice: create temp reservation
```bash
gcloud compute reservations create demo-demo-resv --zone=us-east1-b --accelerator-type=nvidia-h100 --accelerator-count=8 --specific-reservation-for-instances
```
Nina: If we need to open a ticket for quota, I can escalate with the vendor now — but reservations are quicker.
Marta: OK — plan: Ryan will attempt reservation in us-east1-b, Jia on standby to run resize if reservation fails, Samir will add rollback window, Nina will vendor-escalate if both fail. Demo team: please posture demo to start +10m after confirmation.
Ryan: starting reservation attempt now. Will ping when done.
Ryan: reservation created ✅ zone us-east1-b. :tada: tagging demo leads.
Marta: Amazing, thank you everyone — assigning follow-ups: Ryan (resv + monitor), Jia (fallback resize), Samir (rollback timer). I'll send final confirmation to customer at +2m. :thumbsup:
